_comment: Sprites composed from pieces of a 1.8.9 atlas, for modern sprites a single slice record cannot cut correctly. Coordinates are proportional to 'ref' (any pack resolution works); 'size' and every piece box are in ref units. Runs after the slice stage and overwrites it. effect_background_small: 1.8.9 has only the 120x32 effect panel at (0,166); the 32x32 small variant is a later Mojang addition placed at (0,198), which in a 1.8.9 atlas is the effect ICON grid - so the 1.20.2 slicer record cuts four potion icons instead. Composed here from the large panel's left and right 16 columns so it keeps the pack's border art. See docs/known-issues.md #3.
_comment_offhand: hotbar_offhand_left/right: 1.8.9 had no offhand, so the region the 1.20.2 slicer reads (24,22) and (53,22) in widgets.png is empty and the sprites fall back to vanilla - a vanilla-styled slot beside a custom hotbar. Both are a 22x22 box on a 29x24 canvas, at x=0 (left) and x=7 (right), measured from vanilla 1.21.4. The pack's own hotbar is 182x22 = 1px border + 9 20px slots + 1px border, so its left 11 and right 11 columns are a real outer border either side of half a slot; joined they make a closed 22x22 box in the pack's style. Only the pack's pixels - fix and format, never create art. A single 22px cut from one end was tried first and left the box asymmetric: outer border on one side, a thin inter-slot divider on the other.
